events.name: Dog Pool Party
events.description: Your dog or cat, in pink swim goggles, a ruffled pink swim set and arm floats, dances on its back legs at a night pool party and shakes its hips at the camera. Or you do, in your own clothes.

events.name: Husband Emporium
events.description: In a candy-pink 1950s showroom, a salesman shows a shopper the 'Gym Edition' husband flexing on a lit gold pedestal: your partner goes on display, or you go shopping.

events.name: Kiss Cam
events.description: Caught on a stadium's giant kiss cam mid-hug, the couple panic: one covers their face and spins away, the other ducks out of sight, while the people beside them laugh.

events.name: Rubber Band Prank
events.description: One of you aims a long green band at the one at the kitchen counter, lets go, and it snaps straight back into your own face: two pets, the two of you, or you and your pet.
